title: chatPush bodySnippet for jmap-chat-rich: span-text projection
description: Follow-up required by JMAP-nbk3 plan decision D8. build_chat_message_push omits bodySnippet for bodyType application/jmap-chat-rich even when properties requests it, a documented departure from push:121 ('the server returns exactly the requested fields'), because jmap-chat-types has no span type to project plaintext from. push:188: 'When the message's bodyType is "text/markdown" or "application/jmap-chat-rich", the server SHOULD generate a plaintext approximation rather than including raw markup syntax.' Add a span-text projection and emit the snippet; markdown stripping is the same SHOULD (ponytail in docs).
close_reason: Duplicate of JMAP-nbk3.8 (rich-body push snippet from span text)
